title: Reheating Rice Is Not The Problem
description:
How long did yours sit out?

Reheating rice is not what makes you sick - the UK Food Standards Agency says the problem is how the leftover rice was stored before it was reheated. Here is what actually happens to rice left out on the counter.

#shorts #food #foodsafety #leftovers #cooking #humanbody
tags: how long can rice sit out
is leftover rice safe to eat
topic: Reheating rice / fried rice syndrome: FSA - 'It's not the reheating that causes the problem, but the way the rice has been stored before it's reheated.' B. cereus spores survive cooking; they multiply at room temperature and produce a toxin. Chill within 1 hour, eat within 24 hours, reheat once. 2008 case: a 20-year-old died after eating spaghetti left out five days (Palombo, The Conversation). Death is rare.
